name: SortableList

props.description: The rows to order. `label` is spoken in the grip's name and the announcements; a disabled item's grip is inert.
props.name: items
props.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.description: The item keys in order (controlled with onValueChange).
props.name: value

props.description: Called ONCE per drop with the new order — not on every preview step.
props.name: onValueChange

props.description: Draws an item's content beside its grip. Default: the label.
props.name: renderItem

props.description: Stacked rows, or tiles auto-filled into columns (--sortable-list-grid-item-min-inline-size). The keyboard order is the same either way.
props.name: layout

related: Tree — `draggable` for moving nodes within a hierarchy.
Transfer — choose items, not order them.
tagline: Reorder a flat list or a grid of tiles (gh#1173). Each item has a grip: drag it with a pointer (touch included — the grip sets touch-action: none), or focus it and press Space/Enter to lift, the arrows (Home / End) to move, Space/Enter to drop, Esc to cancel. Every step is spoken in a polite live region ("2 of 3"). The order is the value.
usage: DO persist the order in onValueChange — it fires once per drop, so it is safe to save there.
DO give every item a human `label`: a screen reader hears it on lift, every move and drop.
DON'T nest SortableList, and don't put another drag gesture inside an item: the grip is the one drag surface.
Hierarchy (move INTO another node) is Tree `draggable`, not SortableList — this orders a flat list.
useCases: Desktop / dashboard editor: reorder widget tiles (layout="grid").
Settings: order of tabs, columns, menu entries.
